comment: The one list of triples perry publishes a package for. targets: @perryts/perry-target-<triple> (a cross target's runtime, stdlib and UI, from perry-cross-<triple>.tar.gz). ext: @perryts/perry-ext-<triple> (a host's native-extension archives, from its release tarball). Read by scripts/publish/constants.mts (and so stage-npm.sh) and compiled into perry (crates/perry/src/commands/compile/target_packages.rs).
